description.text: Passive: Tryndamere gains  bonus attack damage based on his missing health, up to a maximum amount at 90% missing health.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Tryndamere''' consumes all of his [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|Fury]] to [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed.
description2.text: Active: Tryndamere consumes all of his Fury to heal himself, increased for every point of Fury consumed.

notes.text:
Bloodlust can still be activated even if Tryndamere does not have any Fury.
Bloodlust can be activated at any point of Tryndamere's basic attack.
* Note that if an basic attack will critically strike is determined when the attack windup starts.
** This means that if Bloodlust is cast during Tryndamere's attack windup windup, the attack will use the critical strike chance given by the Fury before the Bloodlust cast.
** Furthermore, the Fury for that basic attack will be given once the windup completes. This lets Tryndamere start building Fury immediately.
Bloodlust's  attack damage gold value:
* At 90% missing health, it is worth 700 / 1225 / 1750 / 2275 / 2800.
* The bonus is worth 7.78 / 13.6125 / 19.445 / 25.2775 / 31.11 more per 1% missing health.
